02f3213.line: honestly, a little? it's the first time in a long time.

04aa8ef.speaker: Treble
04aa8ef.line: but, cool. anyway, are you a crazy person?

0dde843.speaker: Unknown
0dde843.line: I am obviously not a crazy person.

09cbd7b.speaker: Treble
09cbd7b.line: if it was obvious there wouldn't need to be a question.

016e1aa.speaker: Clef
016e1aa.line: We heard about the highway thing.

0af8dea.speaker: Clef
0af8dea.line: How dumb do you have to be to get into that situation?

0d66dd2.speaker: Quaver
0d66dd2.line: I'm not dumb! I've played guitar tons of times before and it's been fine!

0318d6b.speaker: Clef
0318d6b.line: The little guys didn't come out of nowhere. That was on you two.

0735eb8.speaker: Clef
0735eb8.line: You summoned Silence on purpose. To assault the cops.

051b8b2.speaker: Beat
051b8b2.line: I didn't know what I was really doing, so I don't think it counts as being on purpose.

0af56c2.speaker: Clef
0af56c2.line: God, you're dumb. GOD you're dumb. Why would you do that?

0280550.speaker: Treble
0280550.line: you just do not do that around cops.

03c1b43.speaker: Guard
03c1b43.line: You don't do what around cops?

05a6a1b.speaker: Guard
05a6a1b.line: I stopped listening. It's processing time, baby.

0bea3a4.speaker: Treble
0bea3a4.line: well that clears a lot up.

089b103.speaker: Clef
089b103.line: You would have to be! The stuff on the highway was insane!

03b2d30.speaker: Clef
03b2d30.line: I'm literally called a domestic terrorist by someone I don't know every day.

0206792.speaker: Beat
0206792.line: What were we supposed to do in that scenario?

03fa086.speaker: Clef
03fa086.line: You weren't supposed to get INTO IT.

0930595.speaker: Quaver
0930595.line: I've played guitar before and it's never been a problem before yesterday.

07a53f8.speaker: Clef
07a53f8.line: Well, you're lying or you're very lucky.

0c39e62.speaker: Clef
0c39e62.line: Either way, making Silence appear on purpose as a weapon is VERY stupid.

075db79.speaker: Beat
075db79.line: I wouldn't call that a weapon!

03c8495.speaker: Beat
03c8495.line: I was just figuring things out in the moment!

093a6d0.speaker: Treble
093a6d0.line: figuring stuff out is for when cops aren't around.

08661ba.speaker: Guard
08661ba.line: Get up. Time to get processed.

0eabfa0.speaker: Guard
0eabfa0.line: And me. I have to live here too.

009e3c6.speaker: Guard
009e3c6.line: Not if I want my job. Speaking of:

0cf33bc.speaker: Guard
0cf33bc.line: Treble, Clef, you know how to do this by now.

027ab8b.speaker: Clef
027ab8b.line: You can say that without laughing.

095a3c5.speaker: Guard
095a3c5.line: Pink, you seem like you're bad with your hands.

0939dac.speaker: Guard
0939dac.line: Make sure the stuff coming down the conveyor belt looks right.

099f662.speaker: Guard
099f662.line: I will be checking your work.

04eba03.speaker: Beat
04eba03.line: Then what's the point of me doing it?

05922c3.speaker: Clef
05922c3.line: Now all of us are gonna have to stay later and longer and it's never gonna end.

08ca153.speaker: Clef
08ca153.line: You told her to shut up.

05bd908.speaker: Clef
05bd908.line: What if I talk? What are you actually gonna do?

01f332c.speaker: Guard
01f332c.line: I'm sure I'll figure something out.

0439321.speaker: Clef
0439321.line: You think I've never fought anyone before?

00282ba.speaker: Clef
00282ba.line: Dude, punching me in the face is not gonna turn my mouth off.

05e178a.speaker: Clef
05e178a.line: It's not like you're gonna kill me, anyway.

0b740f3.speaker: Guard
0b740f3.line: Whatever. You're like a broken record at this point.

015a106.speaker: Clef
015a106.line: Do you know what I did for a living before the world blew up?

0a429c9.speaker: Clef
0a429c9.line: I am very, very, very good at repeating myself.

03a72da.speaker: Pensato
03a72da.line: Besides me never seeing you around before?

03173b9.speaker: Quaver
03173b9.line: Yeah, but there's enough to crowd the room.

0e05561.speaker: Quaver
0e05561.line: I'm shocked nobody was sitting here.

075022e.speaker: Pensato
075022e.line: I'm definitely not. That's usually the case.

0bad845.speaker: Clef
0bad845.line: And what makes you so special?

0c5d23c.speaker: Pensato
0c5d23c.line: Mm-mm-mm-mm-mm. Before I answer that question: my name is Penny.

0734f10.speaker: Pensato
0734f10.line: Okay, well, legally, from birth, it's Pensato.

065bb0a.speaker: Pensato
065bb0a.line: But on account of us being here, I suspect none of you give a shit about "legal."

07c8921.speaker: Pensato
07c8921.line: So, please, call me Penny. I prefer it.

0db0f15.speaker: Pensato
0db0f15.line: The reason people aren't over here is they're all afraid of pissing me off.

0510015.speaker: Pensato
0510015.line: I'm not really violent, if that's what your real question is.

0da64ca.speaker: Pensato
0da64ca.line: People just want to keep me happy because I can get stuff for them.

0823642.speaker: Pensato
0823642.line: You're a kid, so don't worry about it, but you can't ask me that kind of thing.

0fc710d.speaker: Pensato
0fc710d.line: Nobody can know the what or the how beside me, you know?

032314b.speaker: Pensato
032314b.line: Just...if you really need something that they won't let you have...

075100b.speaker: Pensato
075100b.line: Anyway. I'm sure it's very nice to meet me, but I haven't met you!

05b3a95.speaker: Beat
05b3a95.line: I'm Beat, and this is Quaver.

08dad20.speaker: Clef
08dad20.line: I told you people know us, Beat.

0592b14.speaker: Pensato
0592b14.line: But who are Treble and Clef?

00de2bd.speaker: Pensato
00de2bd.line: Ah, ah, sorry. I've been talking your ears off.

0a26d27.speaker: Pensato
0a26d27.line: Well, enjoy the food. It's terrible.

053872b.speaker: Pensato
053872b.line: I mean, that's what I call them, at least.

09c6f95.speaker: Clef
09c6f95.line: Who the hell cares. Whatever it is, it isn't good.

0d007e4.speaker: Clef
0d007e4.line: Does it matter how not good?

0eb0f3f.speaker: Treble
0eb0f3f.line: i mean, a little bit, yeah.

0c5bfad.speaker: Pensato
0c5bfad.line: God, you are so, so uncurious.

066e94d.speaker: Pensato
066e94d.line: I'll let the kid guess since she likes knowing things she shouldn't.

094ce27.speaker: Quaver
094ce27.line: From the name, it seems kinda obvious.

045c839.speaker: Beat
045c839.line: Silence isn't... a thing you can dampen.

0fd78e9.speaker: Pensato
0fd78e9.line: The what in this case is a field that cancels out a Silence's creation.

0d94164.speaker: Pensato
0d94164.line: Strum, sing, stomp, whatever, it's all peace and love.

06b14a9.speaker: Pensato
06b14a9.line: Well, sure, if you like peace and love.

01003ac.speaker: Pensato
01003ac.line: Anyway, they're building them to try to keep cops safe.

0b8ef6a.speaker: Treble
0b8ef6a.line: help always goes to those who need it most.

05b7191.speaker: Pensato
05b7191.line: As for the how, well, that doesn't matter so much.

0622966.speaker: Pensato
0622966.line: But that's definitely what these do.

0b68cdc.speaker: Pensato
0b68cdc.line: I saw them install a few in this building a week ago.

0db5604.speaker: Pensato
0db5604.line: And they tested it. And it worked.

0340e92.speaker: Pensato
0340e92.line: Took less than a second for the field to kick in.

00224d8.speaker: Beat
00224d8.line: It's not like this is a luxury condo.

0d15a31.speaker: Beat
0d15a31.line: What if they skimped out on parts, or...something.

0c7b133.speaker: Beat
0c7b133.line: It gives us all cancer or something.

0a4ac0a.speaker: Pensato
0a4ac0a.line: I'm sure we would be dead way faster than that if it was broken.

016ac18.speaker: Pensato
016ac18.line: We don't have anything to worry about.

0378835.speaker: Pensato
0378835.line: I mean, as I said, they tested it. And it did.

08da7e8.speaker: Pensato
08da7e8.line: Anyway, those things are, like, layer one of the security of this place.

0365624.speaker: Pensato
0365624.line: Which I'm sure you've already noticed.

0d6d43b.speaker: Pensato
0d6d43b.line: What kind of shit did they get from all of you?

096d16c.speaker: Treble
096d16c.line: isn't that, like, information economy, or, whatever

0a6f0e6.speaker: Clef
0a6f0e6.line: Like, the stuff they grabbed when we were arrested?

03c5211.speaker: Beat
03c5211.line: Nothing crazy. Our instruments, of course.

0fe6002.speaker: Pensato
0fe6002.line: Sure. It's why we're all here.

05b5bb0.speaker: Pensato
05b5bb0.line: I mean, I know what a tape player is.

01de639.speaker: Pensato
01de639.line: That's pretty rare. I'd be pissed.

0a84034.speaker: Pensato
0a84034.line: So, last night, I'm sure you're-

057f14b.speaker: Beat
057f14b.line: I'm getting the sense that this just happens here?

096d39d.speaker: Pensato
096d39d.line: But they don't just do all that because they hate us.

03a88c5.speaker: Pensato
03a88c5.line: Basically: there has to be footage going 24/7 in a place like this, right?

01e9e28.speaker: Pensato
01e9e28.line: They can't risk being seen on that footage doing anything really blunt-force.

08b5f21.speaker: Pensato
08b5f21.line: So they pay off one of us to do it.

0a64c07.speaker: Clef
0a64c07.line: It's always the biggest dude here.

081de60.speaker: Beat
081de60.line: Maybe I'm just being stupid...but I still don't...get...why?

0a28b59.speaker: Pensato
0a28b59.line: If you're tired, you won't have any energy to put anywhere.

00adfa7.speaker: Pensato
00adfa7.line: I'm off. Gotta check something. Til' later, pals.

06ceb13.speaker: Beat
06ceb13.line: Oh, shit, I forgot to ask her something.

0099da0.speaker: Clef
0099da0.line: Can't say it in front of us?

0394f88.speaker: Beat
0394f88.line: Hey, uh, you wouldn't happen to know where Penny's cell is, would you?

0a1f633.speaker: Guard
0a1f633.line: You just missed a callout, newbie.

066e931.speaker: Beat
066e931.line: Bet you can't beat that high score.

0823404.speaker: Beat
0823404.line: The tape thing! The thing I had!

0fff091.speaker: Pensato
0fff091.line: Oh, hey, they were looking for you.

0596473.speaker: Guard
0596473.line: Pink, you kept us waiting. You're up.

09c94d3.speaker: Guard
09c94d3.line: You're new, so you get a turn first.

08cf98b.speaker: Guard
08cf98b.line: If you don't move, we'll give your spot to the kid.

00955e2.speaker: Treble
00955e2.line: he's bluffing. there are laws about that.

00321ac.speaker: Pensato
00321ac.line: He's not bluffing. There are laws about all of this.

0cd9f36.speaker: Pensato
0cd9f36.line: None of them are being followed, and nobody cares.

0696eab.speaker: Pensato
0696eab.line: Beat, just, you know. Don't get hurt too bad.

0627ca4.speaker: Beat
0627ca4.line: I've never had a factory job before.

0a7b586.speaker: Beat
0a7b586.line: But there was something close, once.

0ed1624.speaker: Beat
0ed1624.line: When I was younger, like, way younger,

0779eff.speaker: Beat
0779eff.line: ...like, too young to have a job young,

0558f26.speaker: Beat
0558f26.line: this guy came to my school.

0581bbf.speaker: Beat
0581bbf.line: He had a little table set up with pamphlets and things.

036062e.speaker: Beat
036062e.line: He flagged a bunch of kids down,

001cffe.speaker: Beat
001cffe.line: and asked if we wanted a bit of money.

0f2296b.speaker: Beat
0f2296b.line: "For video games or toys or whatever stuff you like."

007e675.speaker: Beat
007e675.line: I forgot about the guy with the pamphlets until a bit later.

02f4dc4.speaker: Beat
02f4dc4.line: At that point, we were dead in the middle of summer.

05a1de3.speaker: Beat
05a1de3.line: They were angry I missed my first day.

083a987.speaker: Beat
083a987.line: Said I "made the other kids pick up the slack."

07078d4.speaker: Beat
07078d4.line: My mom was furious with them, mostly,

071ddb3.speaker: Beat
071ddb3.line: but also me, for agreeing to do it.

0efedaa.speaker: Beat
0efedaa.line: From that next morning onwards I got up at 6 AM every day to detassel corn.

04fbe34.speaker: Beat
04fbe34.line: But at least the pay is also terrible.

0ab43d8.speaker: Beat
0ab43d8.line: All I know that even with that, they still had all the kids go back out the next day.

00fe72e.speaker: Beat
00fe72e.line: I know that because they called my mom again when I refused to go back.

042490a.speaker: Beat
042490a.line: We got a check in the mail later for sixty two dollars.

00f4994.speaker: Beat
00f4994.line: The way corn detasseling works is this:

0892141.speaker: Beat
0892141.line: They throw a ton of kids (and it's always kids) on a giant metal rig.

0729ca5.speaker: Beat
0729ca5.line: You're not really strapped in or seated. You just kind of hold on to the side.

037a7e9.speaker: Beat
037a7e9.line: Everyone gets these itchy, shitty, sweaty gloves,

015cd2e.speaker: Beat
015cd2e.line: and is told to pick the tassels off the corn.

01281ea.speaker: Beat
01281ea.line: This is so that the corn can't pollinate itself.

0a8158a.speaker: Beat
0a8158a.line: Because if it does, they can't use the seeds for a hybrid plant.

00a1e6e.speaker: Beat
00a1e6e.line: The purpose of the hybrid plant is to make it produce more corn.

0ed8882.speaker: Beat
0ed8882.line: So that they can sell more corn and corn by-products.

04b0e34.speaker: Beat
04b0e34.line: Anyway, the kids pick the tassels off as the rig goes through the field.

0a5a81a.speaker: Beat
0a5a81a.line: They are not nice about it.

0616af9.speaker: Guard
0616af9.line: You know the answer to that.

07b1552.speaker: Beat
07b1552.line: Wasn't there supposed to be breakfast?

059e630.speaker: Guard
059e630.line: You missed it! Good job, bozos.

00c6659.speaker: Beat
00c6659.line: I don't know. I've never been to prison before.

072ebcf.speaker: Guard
072ebcf.line: Your shift already started. Get to the shop floor.

002fa7a.speaker: Beat
002fa7a.line: I don't feel like I slept at all.

074cc9f.speaker: Clef
074cc9f.line: Never got the chance for someone to tell you?

0694497.speaker: Clef
0694497.line: It's like a couch being dragged on the floor.

0530b40.speaker: Beat
0530b40.line: I hope that's not a sign of something worse.

0ad0be6.speaker: Clef
0ad0be6.line: You can't end up in one of these places without running into some cause of death.

03564a8.speaker: Clef
03564a8.line: It means more time. Time is good.

0ebefd2.speaker: Beat
0ebefd2.line: When did you get back last night?

0956b43.speaker: Clef
0956b43.line: DC is a sack of shit.

0ee5813.speaker: Guard
0ee5813.line: Hey. Quit talking. You know the drill.

0ad761c.speaker: Unknown
0ad761c.line: I hope you know that it's crazy that this is just normal to you two.

0f07785.speaker: Treble
0f07785.line: not any less than anything else in prison.

0d39a79.speaker: Clef
0d39a79.line: The guy they got is a walking bench press.

08d48a8.speaker: Clef
08d48a8.line: Well, you had a better night than I did, then.

0458b0a.speaker: Treble
0458b0a.line: was dc a piece of shit

04ecd54.speaker: Clef
04ecd54.line: You KNOW the answer to that.

0ce73f3.speaker: Clef
0ce73f3.line: Anyway. I handled it as well as I probably could have.

066989a.speaker: Guard
066989a.line: Hey. Quit talking. You know the drill.

0eb50dd.speaker: Beat
0eb50dd.line: Does anyone else feel like shit?

0f91fcd.speaker: Clef
0f91fcd.line: I think that's called "you're in jail."

0d12550.speaker: Beat
0d12550.line: You know the feeling when you're about to sneeze but you don'tsneeze?

0e207ef.speaker: Beat
0e207ef.line: It's like that, but nausea. Like the shape around nausea.

0fd70b1.speaker: Clef
0fd70b1.line: What, the questioning? The whole song and dance? Yeah.

0231309.speaker: Clef
0231309.line: I'm surprised you didn't already know. You seem so clued-in.

022038e.speaker: Clef
022038e.line: How was it? How was he? Same as usual?

05e543a.speaker: Clef
05e543a.line: ...uh, hey, are you in there? What's up?

07efecc.speaker: Treble
07efecc.line: clef, i'm fine. i'm just exhausted.

0029a94.speaker: Guard
0029a94.line: Refusing to comply with a guard's directions.

08ac3bb.speaker: Guard
08ac3bb.line: Just don't refuse to comply in general.

0802120.speaker: Guard
0802120.line: Honestly we don't really care about that one.

0292222.speaker: Guard
0292222.line: Obviously, no singing, or whistling, or whatever.

049f1e9.speaker: Guard
049f1e9.line: Basically, don't be an idiot. Or you go boom.

06c73a2.speaker: Guard
06c73a2.line: Well, here I think you have it easy.

0362903.speaker: Guard
0362903.line: Welcome to what amounts to a permanent fricken' vacation.

00f7bbf.speaker: Guard
00f7bbf.line: Trust me. It's easier to be in here than out there.

05c19da.speaker: Guard
05c19da.line: But you know what sucks more?

09bfc73.speaker: Guard
09bfc73.line: Do not forget this: you've got it better off than I do.

0c11408.speaker: Guard
0c11408.line: Come on, dude. This isn't communism.

047dc1e.speaker: Guard
047dc1e.line: That's what I was going to say, actually.

0015a68.speaker: Guard
0015a68.line: I wish I was one of you guys.

04e619d.speaker: Guard
04e619d.line: Wouldn't have to worry about anything.

0cfa660.speaker: Guard
0cfa660.line: Could just do whatever I want until I got told to do something else.

0f0dcf4.speaker: Guard
0f0dcf4.line: Like...cats. You guys basically get to be treated like my cat.

0120b0d.speaker: Guard
0120b0d.line: That's kind of what I was going to get into.

0b871a7.speaker: Guard
0b871a7.line: You don't have to worry about things like that anymore.

04ae480.speaker: Guard
04ae480.line: You get to just sit here and get told what to do.

0b53d96.speaker: Guard
0b53d96.line: You don't even have to be a person, anymore.

082a275.speaker: Guard
082a275.line: Well now I am thinking that.

012571a.speaker: Guard
012571a.line: You threw me off. I haven't eaten since...

00960b3.speaker: Guard
00960b3.line: I can't remember what I was talking about.

0c4c957.speaker: Guard
0c4c957.line: No, don't worry. She can get lippy.

004a47f.speaker: Guard
004a47f.line: She'll see what it gets her.

06e3b66.speaker: RunningGuy
06e3b66.line: I think that's a new high score

075c7a1.speaker: Guard
075c7a1.line: Some of 'em do it just to see how far they can get.

00f75cc.speaker: Guard
00f75cc.line: Hey, Attacca, how far was that?

08d25ae.speaker: RunningGuy
08d25ae.line: I'm guessing about half a meter better than last time

0ac0b4e.speaker: Guard
0ac0b4e.line: They don't even want to get out. It's just a game at this point.

02082f2.speaker: Guard
02082f2.line: Get lost, unless you also want to get a rubber shower.

06d0c61.speaker: Guard
06d0c61.line: And me. I have to live here too.

01c1538.speaker: Guard
01c1538.line: Not if I want my job. Speaking of:

0b35e33.speaker: Guard
0b35e33.line: Treble, Clef, you know how to do this by now.

095d17b.speaker: Clef
095d17b.line: You can say that without laughing.

0f1dce3.speaker: Guard
0f1dce3.line: Pink, you seem like you're bad with your hands.

0ba621e.speaker: Guard
0ba621e.line: You get the easiest job in the world.

047e815.speaker: Guard
047e815.line: Make sure the stuff coming down the conveyor belt looks right.

06950d6.speaker: Guard
06950d6.line: I will be checking your work.

0ad3149.speaker: Beat
0ad3149.line: Then what's the point of me doing it?

0488fee.speaker: Clef
0488fee.line: Let's get in the car and get moving.

0ef476e.speaker: Penny
0ef476e.line: You need to move now. We don't have another shot.

09cf4fa.speaker: Penny
09cf4fa.line: Trust me. I have another way clear.

096dd6a.speaker: Penny
096dd6a.line: And if I can't keep the storm brewing here, you won't.

0e2fb6f.speaker: Quaver
0e2fb6f.line: I only found the mic and guitar!

02d7caf.speaker: Clef
02d7caf.line: Beat, we need to go now.

0d99f88.speaker: Beat
0d99f88.line: Go on ahead. I'll figure something out.

004c5dd.speaker: Quaver
004c5dd.line: Do you really need it? Now?
